best_idea: Replace the 65536‑entry 16‑bit histogram with a 256‑entry 8‑bit histogram, which halves the memset size and loop work per pass, giving a big speed‑up on the Apple‑Silicon CPU.

best_lineage.idea: Replace the recursive merge sort with a stable two‑pass 16‑bit radix sort (first by the low 16 bits, then by the high 16 bits) using linear counting‑sort passes and histogram arrays; this reduces recursion, gives better cache locality and is well‑suited to the ARM NEON pipeline, yielding higher throughput.

Replace the two‑pass 16‑bit LSD radix sort with four 8‑bit passes (using a 256‑entry histogram and a single temporary buffer). The extra pass reduces per‑pass work and improves cache locality on the Apple‑Silicon NEON pipeline, raising overall throughput.
